description: Shared metadata and rule tables for OMLE function registries v0.1.

parameter_conventions.optional_parameters: Optional named keyword arguments that follow the positional list and are passed by name, not by position.
parameter_conventions.variadic: Only positional arguments may be variadic, and only the final positional argument may be variadic.

input_kinds.integer: Any signed or unsigned integer type.
input_kinds.comparable: Types that support equality and ordering where applicable.

type_rules.same_as(arg): Return the same type as arg.
type_rules.numeric_promotion(a,b): Promote numeric operands to a common numeric type.
type_rules.numeric_promotion(args): Promote all referenced numeric operands to a common numeric type.
type_rules.float_division(x,y): Return a floating-point type for division, promoting integer operands to float as needed.
type_rules.float_if_numeric(x): Return a floating-point type suitable for the numeric input domain of x.
type_rules.float_if_numeric(args): Return a floating-point type suitable for the numeric input domain shared by the referenced numeric arguments.
type_rules.common_supertype(args): Return the common compatible type across args.
type_rules.same_as_non_null(args): Return the common type of the first non-null-compatible arguments.
type_rules.same_as_non_null_result_values(args): Return the common type of non-null mapped/result-side values only, excluding key-side match inputs.
type_rules.target_type: Return the type named by the cast target_type argument.

measure_level_rules.same_as(arg): Return the same measure level as arg.
measure_level_rules.same_as_non_null(args): Return the measure level of the first non-null-compatible arguments.
measure_level_rules.same_as_non_null_result_values(args): Return the measure level of non-null mapped/result-side values only, excluding key-side match inputs.
measure_level_rules.common_branch_measure_level(args): Return a compatible measure level derived from conditional/result branches.
measure_level_rules.continuous_if_numeric(args): Return CONTINUOUS for numeric arithmetic results.

null_rules.strict: If any argument is null, the result is null.
null_rules.coalesce: Return the first non-null argument; null if all are null.
null_rules.if_condition: If condition is null, the result is null. Otherwise evaluate only the selected branch.
null_rules.is_missing: Return true for null inputs, false otherwise.
null_rules.is_not_missing: Return false for null inputs, true otherwise.
null_rules.three_valued: Boolean logic uses three-valued semantics. For AND and OR, null may be resolved when the other operand determines the result. Otherwise the result is null.
